release_summary: Role-based Master KPI access, custom roles, maintenance mode, and activity logging
release_details: Admins can control which Master KPI pages each role sees and create custom roles with their own access. Developers get a private tools area with maintenance mode and a full activity log that records sign-ins, KPI saves, and admin changes — including what was added, changed, or removed. Only Developers can assign the Developer role.
change_title: Master KPI access by role — choose which pages Viewer, Editor, and custom roles can open
Custom roles — create roles with their own Master KPI page access and optional KPI edit permission
Maintenance mode — block Viewers and Editors while Admins and Developers keep access
Activity log — automatic tracking of sign-ins, KPI saves, and admin changes (Developer → Activity)
Detailed data entry logs — expand a row to see what KPI values were added, changed, or removed
Developer role has full admin access and a private Developer section in the sidebar
Only Developers can assign or change the Developer role — Admins cannot
Renamed Dev to Developer across the app for clearer role labels
